{{Quote|The enemy is maneuvering well. But soon we will crush them. Our numbers are overwhelming.|The Executor, reporting on the Battle of Ebaq|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>}}
A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''executor''' accompanied the Yuuzhan Vong task force to the [[Treskov system]], where it was to engage the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] remnants. The [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Executor]] reported to [[Nom Anor]] and [[Yoog Skell]] via a [[villip]] that the [[Battle of Ebaq|battle]] was going well for the Yuuzhan Vong, before it was ultimately lost.
